description: Return configured TLD-specific registration eligibility, required fields, and checkout flow choices for a named TLD or domain. Check this result before describing special-TLD requirements; do not assume all .bank, .insurance, .pharmacy, .us, or .aero domains use the same process. A missing configured requirement is not a guarantee of unrestricted eligibility. Ask the customer to choose only when the result has multiple paths; collect sensitive fields in checkout, not chat.

partner_id.description: Optional partner id used to resolve a matching restricted-TLD flow.

requirement_use_case.description: Restricted-TLD flow id when a TLD has multiple eligibility paths, e.g. preapproved or approval-help.

tld.description: TLD to inspect, with or without leading dot.

name: get_domain_requirements
